mapper.select: SELECT dictionary_key AS key, label, enabled, sort_order, version FROM sys_dictionary WHERE dictionary_key = #{key} ORDER BY sort_order, dictionary_key
SELECT option_value AS value, label, i18n, enabled, sort_order, version FROM sys_dictionary_option WHERE dictionary_key = #{key} ORDER BY sort_order, option_value
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dictionary (dictionary_key, label, enabled, sort_order) VALUES (#{key}, #{label}, #{enabled}, #{sortOrder}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_dictionary WHERE dictionary_key = #{key} AND version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dictionary_option (dictionary_key, option_value, label, i18n, enabled, sort_order) VALUES (#{key}, #{value}, #{label}, #{i18n,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{enabled}, #{sortOrder}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_dictionary_option WHERE dictionary_key = #{key} AND option_value = #{value} AND version = #{version}
